messages:
marta: Quick RFC follow-up: decide validator mesh routing for model admissions. Central router vs per-prober routing?

devin: Central = easy telemetry + dedupe, but single logical choke.

alyssa: Per-prober scales. Risk: duplicate expensive golden benches.

marta: Proposal: distributed routing + tiny coordination service that issues "golden leases" per model_id. Lease holder runs canonical golden bench.

sam: If lease acquisition is slow, prober can run a provisional local probe and mark it provisional until golden completes.

kevin: Lease TTL ops suggestion: 30s default + backoff jitter. Avoid long locks.

alyssa: Routing should be size-aware (max_seq, param_bin) so heavy models go to big-GPU pools.

marta: Agreed. Keys: model_id, max_seq, param_bin. Deterministic mapping to shard pools.

devin: Add runtime ABI checks. Include abi_hash in fingerprint; pools advertise supported_abis.

sam: Router match = fingerprint.abi_hash in pool.supported_abis.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Changing router config will trigger canary autoscaler (10->50). Coordinate with eng-infra.

marta: We'll gate rollout with canary + infra signoff.

kevin: Bench dedupe: bench_cache keyed by (model_id, bench_profile) TTL 5m + jitter. bench_profile includes model_binary_digest + quant_tag.

devin: Fallback: if no compatible pool, run fast CPU smoke to fail-fast and tag model "needs_full_bench".

marta: Smoke runs go to high-priority queue for quick feedback.

sam: UX: owners get /models/<id>/admit-report link immediately showing provisional/golden/failed + perf numbers.

kevin: Impl sketch: router.match_keys=["model_id","max_seq","param_bin","abi_hash"]
lease_service.acquire(model_id, role="golden", ttl=30s)
bench_cache.set((model_id,bench_profile),result,ttl=300s)

alyssa: Tests: key derivation unit tests, integration with small/med/large pools, chaos test where lease service slows.

marta: Actions: devin protos lease service (EOW); sam bench cache PR (Wed); alyssa integration tests (Fri); kevin sync infra (tomorrow).

devin: I'll post API doc after this.

marta: If no objections I'll open RFC follow-up to capture decisions + rollout checklist.

alyssa: No objections. :thumbsup:

sam: SGTM.

kevin: Fine by me.

marta: Closing loop. Ping here if infra-bot flags deploy alerts during canary.
